npcAlignmentGapFill.note: Corrected from the previous run: NPCs spawn on walkable/ROAD cells (NpcLayer.tsx SPAWN_CELLS), which never get a `#plot-{index}` element (only "ground" cells do) — comparing against `#plot-N` always found nothing (null). Correct comparison is NPC element vs the terrain `.town-cell` at the same row/col, the layer an NPC actually stands on. Measured with `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` emulated (the app already honors it — NpcLayer.tsx freezes NPCs, npc.css sets `transition:none`) so a slow multi-step gesture cannot straddle the NPC's own ~2.5s walk tick and measure it mid-glide.
npcAlignmentGapFill.interpretation: PASS = pinch/pan introduces no ADDITIONAL layer desync beyond this pre-existing, zoom-independent NPC offset.

g7_no_remount_on_zoom.method: Marked `.town-grid` and one `.town-cell--road` node with a JS-property stamp before a full pinch-in + pan + pinch-out + 전체 보기 toggle cycle, then re-queried the DOM and compared node identity (===) plus marker survival. A remount would create a NEW element (marker gone, `===` false against the saved reference); the memo blowing would only affect TownTerrain's re-render count, but a remount is the observable symptom that would also destroy the marker, which is what this checks directly.
